# Labelled corpus for precision and recall (cmd/presidiocmp, TestLabelledCorpus).
# A document starts with a line "=== <name>". Personal data is written
# [[kind:value]] with kind one of email, phone, iban, nir, card, ipv4, ipv6;
# the brackets are removed and the value's position becomes a gold span.
# Everything else is not personal data, including the decoys (versions,
# ISBN, SIRET, MAC addresses, a card that fails Luhn, invalid addresses).
# Values are fictitious; checksums are valid where the kind has one.
